summary: Successfully implemented ReadOnlyView for MeteredWindowStore (KAFKA-20497). Added readOnly(IsolationLevel) method that returns a custom ReadOnlyView inner class implementing ReadOnlyWindowStore<K,V>. The view applies proper serdes (serializing keys, deserializing values), records metrics through fetchSensor and iteratorDurationSensor, and tracks open iterators. All 38 MeteredWindowStoreTest tests pass, including 12 new readOnly-related tests.
